title: Time tracker for projects and tasks
when: The user wants to start and stop a timer per project or task, edit entries and see daily and weekly totals of hours, maybe with earnings.
prompt:
Goal: One running timer at a time, exact totals per day and project, and clean CSV for invoices.
Steps:
1. Entry { id, project, task, start, end } in epoch ms; starting a new timer stops the running one.
2. logic.mjs: duration(entry, now), totalsBy(entries, project | day), splitAtMidnight for entries crossing days, overlaps(entries), formatHours as 1:35 and 1.58, earnings(hours, rate).
3. Top bar: labeled project select, task input, a big Start and Stop button with aria-pressed; elapsed recomputed from start.
4. Today list plus a weekly table with th headers: projects as rows, days as columns, totals.
5. Edit start and end with time inputs; end must follow start; warn on overlaps.
6. Persist in localStorage tracker.v1 guarded; CSV export per week with quoted fields.
7. test.mjs: midnight split, totals, overlaps, CSV quoting.
Quality bar:
- A reload keeps the running timer.
- Weekly totals match the entries.
- Decimal and clock formats both shown.
Pitfalls:
- Counting seconds with intervals.
- Two running timers.
- Unquoted commas in CSV.
Verify:
- [ ] Table uses th.
- [ ] Inputs labeled.
- [ ] Totals tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (time math), test.mjs.

examples.input: controle de horas trabalhadas por projeto
examples.output: Start/Stop per project, week table, 32.5 h total, CSV export
